name: merge-to-branch
description: Squash every committed change from the current task branch into an explicitly named local target branch.

interface.shortDescription: Squash current work into a chosen target branch
interface.longDescription: Land the complete committed tree difference as one squash commit in a user-specified local target branch. Refresh the target when it has an upstream and verify identical source and target trees after landing.
defaultPrompt: Use $merge-to-branch:merge-to-branch to squash every committed change from my current branch into <target-branch> as one commit.
